title: Private sector companies with wet works arms

tellings.quote: they all kind of seem to warn about the same thing um particularly from the private sector that there's certain uh private sector companies that they that they you know claim have some nefarious actors that will do kinetic activity.

plain: Eric Burlison, a US congressman, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the people who have come to him with UFO claims, including former intelligence officer David Grusch and a man named Jake Barber, all warn about the same thing. He says they claim certain private companies tied to the secret have bad actors who will carry out "kinetic activity", meaning physical violence, sometimes called wet works. If true, it would mean those who speak out could be in real danger.
